answer_1.quote: Automatic summarization aims to produce summaries that are succinct, coherent, relevant, and crucially -factually correct.

answer_2.quote: We introduce QAGS, an automatic model-based evaluation metric for measuring the factual consistency of model-generated text.

answer_4.quote: We collect human judgments on Amazon Mechanical Turk via ParlAI.
answer_4.guideline: Workers are instructed to mark non-grammatical sentences as not consistent, and copies of article sentences as consistent.
